seats.name: Target & Attribute Parity Reviewer
seats.responsibility: Verifies 1:1 semantic alignment of targets, deps, sources, flags, complete migration of all convertible libraries (including reference/bitrot-prevention targets without # @bazel2gn:skip), 3-tier idiomatic Bazel visibility scoping, that the change modifies only build-definition files (no source edits), and shared lint config reuse: lint_config points at the defining rust_lint_config (no new alias/wrapper targets) and default lint dicts are loaded from the //build/config/rust/lints .bzl instead of copied.

seats.name: Dual-Build & Sentinel Reviewer
seats.responsibility: Verifies BAZEL2GN SENTINEL synchronization, rejects target-level # @bazel2gn:skip on convertible or reference libraries and rejects duplicate/unmigrated convertible targets above the sentinel in BUILD.gn, verifies verify_bazel2gn registration in //build/bazel2gn_verification_targets.gni, 3-tier visibility parity, build-only change scope, and lint_config label parity (same-named GN config() next to the Bazel rust_lint_config, no new alias + forwarding-config wrapper pairs).
